title: Hospital Capacity & Revenue Optimization
thesis: Snowflake forecasts hospital admissions, optimizes bed allocation, and predicts revenue — replacing reactive capacity management with proactive ML-driven planning across 12 private hospitals

talking_points: Group bed utilization at 84% — 3 hospitals above 90% (capacity risk).
Revenue per bed-day: ฿18,500 average (target: ฿22,000) — ฿1.4B annual gap.
Cancellation rate: 8.2% — costing ฿340M in lost revenue opportunity.
show: Point at utilization gauge by hospital
tabs.call_out: ฿1.4B revenue gap — 3 hospitals at capacity risk

transition.line: Let's see what the admission forecasts predict for this week.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts admissions 14 days ahead by hospital and department.
Bangkok General Hospital: predicted 92% utilization by Friday — defer non-urgent electives.
Chiang Mai hospital has capacity headroom — redirect international patients.
show: Click Bangkok General for department detail
tabs.call_out: 14-day admission forecast enables proactive bed management

transition.line: How do we optimize revenue within capacity constraints?

talking_points: Revenue per bed-day varies 3x between departments: cardiac ฿45K vs general ฿15K.
AI recommends: shift elective orthopedics from Bangkok to Samut Prakan (saves beds for cardiac).
Dynamic table auto-calculates optimal case mix to maximize revenue within capacity.
tabs.call_out: Optimal case mix + capacity allocation = ฿1.4B revenue uplift potential

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
Kinesis streams bed census; ML.FORECAST predicts admissions; Alerts trigger when capacity critical.
Thai private healthcare: ฿280B market. This optimizes 12 hospitals, 3,200 beds.
